section_1_cloze.passage:
Yesterday, I was given a written assignment with the theme of "The One I Admire" by our English teacher Mr. Brown. As I sat down to put [41] to paper, many ideas rushed through my mind. There were so many events and [42] that shaped the person I was today. Which one should I choose? After much [43], I decided to write about my dad who [44] last year. I thought and thought about two [45] of life that he had followed all his life. Thinking about him in this way made me realize how much he [46] my life.

My dad was born into a poor family. [47] his awareness of the problems caused by a stomach disorder, the disease [48] took its toll on him. It was very difficult for me to see my father lost in a world of turmoil(混乱). He [49] every aspect of my life from young child to teenager. So many times I sat at his side as he [50] for his life in the hospital. He was [51] a fighter, but he could only fight for so long. When he died, my life changed so much. How could a [52] be taken from his family?

From the day he died until now I'd been trying to but I couldn't find anyone else or anything else to rely on. I felt I needed to forget the [53] he left to me. I wanted to [54] the loss his death caused to me by believing he had been perfect. Sitting down and writing my thoughts made me realize I didn't necessarily [55] him. I just needed to love him.

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配。put pen to paper 意为“开始动笔写”，符合语境中作者坐下来准备写作文的场景。
questions.supplement:
A(pen)：语境句：She finally put pen to paper and began her novel. 固定搭配：put pen to paper, a stroke of the pen
B(attention)：语境句：He didn't pay any attention to my warning. 固定搭配：pay attention to, catch one's attention
C(answer)：语境句：She didn't give a direct answer to the question. 固定搭配：in answer to, answer for
D(dream)：语境句：He achieved success beyond his wildest dreams. 固定搭配：beyond one's wildest dreams, dream of

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。上文提到要写“我钦佩的人”，下文作者选择了写自己的父亲。结合语境，是过去的许多“事件(events)”和“人物(individuals)”塑造了今天的我。
questions.supplement:
A(scenes)：语境句：The movie contains several violent scenes. 固定搭配：behind the scenes, on the scene
B(stories)：语境句：He is very good at telling stories. 固定搭配：tell a story, make up a story
C(individuals)：语境句：The law applies to both businesses and individuals. 固定搭配：private individuals, respect for the individual
D(spots)：语境句：This is one of the most popular tourist spots in the city. 固定搭配：on the spot, hit the spot

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。after much thought 意为“经过深思熟虑后”，符合作者在众多素材中最终做出决定的心理过程。
questions.supplement:
A(declaration)：语境句：They signed a declaration of human rights. 固定搭配：a declaration of independence, a joint declaration
B(thought)：语境句：After much thought, I decided to accept the offer. 固定搭配：after much thought, lost in thought
C(discussion)：语境句：The proposal is currently under discussion. 固定搭配：under discussion, a heated discussion
D(construction)：语境句：The new railway is still under construction. 固定搭配：under construction, building construction

questions.explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。由下文中的“When he died”可知，作者的父亲在去年“去世(passed away)”。
questions.supplement:
A(lay off)：语境句：The company had to lay off 200 workers due to the crisis. 固定搭配：lay off staff, be laid off
B(moved away)：语境句：My best friend moved away to another city last year. 固定搭配：move away from, move away to
C(stepped aside)：语境句：He stepped aside to let the pregnant woman pass. 固定搭配：step aside for, step aside from
D(passed away)：语境句：His grandfather passed away peacefully in his sleep. 固定搭配：pass away peacefully, pass away suddenly

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。laws of life 在此处引申为“生活法则、人生准则”，指父亲一生所遵循的生活准则。
questions.supplement:
A(theories)：语境句：Einstein is famous for his theory of relativity. 固定搭配：in theory, build a theory
B(laws)：语境句：He strictly followed his own laws of life. 固定搭配：break the law, obey the law
C(aims)：语境句：Our main aim is to improve the quality of education. 固定搭配：achieve an aim, with the aim of
D(instructions)：语境句：Please read the instructions carefully before using. 固定搭配：follow instructions, specific instructions

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。上文提到过去的事件和人物“塑造(shaped)”了我，此处呼应，意识到父亲极大程度上“改变/影响(changed)”了我的生活。
questions.supplement:
A(stopped)：语境句：The rain finally stopped in the afternoon. 固定搭配：stop from doing, stop by
B(ruined)：语境句：The bad weather ruined our holiday plans. 固定搭配：ruin one's health, ruin one's chances
C(improved)：语境句：Her spoken English has improved significantly. 固定搭配：improve on, be greatly improved
D(changed)：语境句：Meeting him completely changed my life. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better

questions.explanation: 考查介词辨析。前句提到父亲知道胃病引起的问题，后句说疾病还是夺走了他的生命，两者之间是让步转折关系，故选 Despite (尽管)。
questions.supplement:
A(Despite)：语境句：Despite the heavy rain, they continued the match. 固定搭配：despite the fact that, despite oneself
B(Besides)：语境句：Besides English, he can speak French fluently. 固定搭配：besides doing, nothing besides
C(Without)：语境句：We couldn't have finished the project without your help. 固定搭配：without doubt, go without saying
D(Beyond)：语境句：The beauty of the scenery is beyond description. 固定搭配：beyond recognition, beyond belief

questions.explanation: 考查副词辨析。疾病“最终(eventually)”还是夺去了他的生命(took its toll on him)。
questions.supplement:
A(seriously)：语境句：You shouldn't take his joke so seriously. 固定搭配：take seriously, seriously ill
B(directly)：语境句：The new policy will directly affect our lives. 固定搭配：deal directly with, report directly to
C(eventually)：语境句：He worked hard and eventually became the manager. 固定搭配：eventually succeed, eventually discover
D(completely)：语境句：The old building was completely destroyed in the fire. 固定搭配：completely ignore, completely different

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。由上下文可知，父亲从我幼时到青少年时期“影响(affected)”了我生活的方方面面。
questions.supplement:
A(lit)：语境句：A bright smile lit up her face. 固定搭配：light up, light a fire
B(affected)：语境句：The global economic crisis affected many industries. 固定搭配：be deeply affected by, affect one's health
C(woke)：语境句：A sudden noise woke me up in the middle of the night. 固定搭配：wake up, wake up to
D(denied)：语境句：He firmly denied having stolen the money. 固定搭配：deny doing sth, deny access to

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。根据后文“He was definitely a fighter”可知，父亲在医院里为生命而“搏斗/抗争(fought)”。
questions.supplement:
A(paid)：语境句：I have paid for the tickets in advance. 固定搭配：pay for, pay attention
B(left)：语境句：She left the company to start her own business. 固定搭配：leave for, leave behind
C(fought)：语境句：He fought bravely for his country during the war. 固定搭配：fight for, fight against
D(sought)：语境句：They urgently sought shelter from the storm. 固定搭配：seek for, seek out

questions.explanation: 考查副词辨析。为了强调父亲面对病魔时的坚强，作者评价他“绝对/无疑(definitely)”是一个斗士。
questions.supplement:
A(definitely)：语境句：This is definitely the best book I have ever read. 固定搭配：definitely true, will definitely do
B(secretly)：语境句：He secretly planned a surprise party for his wife. 固定搭配：secretly admire, secretly hope
C(publicly)：语境句：The company publicly apologized for the mistake. 固定搭配：speak publicly, publicly available
D(partly)：语境句：His failure was partly due to his lack of experience. 固定搭配：be partly responsible, partly because

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。文章通篇在描写父亲，此处表达悲痛之情：怎么能把一位“父亲(father)”从他的家庭中夺走呢？
questions.supplement:
A(fighter)：语境句：He proved himself to be a strong fighter. 固定搭配：freedom fighter, a real fighter
B(kid)：语境句：She is just a kid and needs more patience. 固定搭配：no kidding, a little kid
C(pet)：语境句：Keeping a pet can teach children responsibility. 固定搭配：pet dog, teacher's pet
D(father)：语境句：He is a loving father of three children. 固定搭配：founding father, like father like son

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。父亲去世给作者留下了巨大的“痛苦(pain)”，作者想要忘记这种痛苦。
questions.supplement:
A(pressure)：语境句：Students face a lot of pressure before the final exams. 固定搭配：under pressure, blood pressure
B(fortune)：语境句：He made a large fortune in the real estate market. 固定搭配：make a fortune, tell one's fortune
C(joy)：语境句：The birth of their daughter brought them great joy. 固定搭配：tears of joy, a source of joy
D(pain)：语境句：Time will eventually heal the pain of losing a loved one. 固定搭配：in pain, relieve the pain

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。ease the loss 意为“缓解失去亲人的痛苦”，作者试图通过把父亲完美化来减轻内心的悲伤。
questions.supplement:
A(repair)：语境句：It took them two hours to repair the broken car. 固定搭配：repair the damage, beyond repair
B(ease)：语境句：The medicine helped to ease the pain in her back. 固定搭配：ease the pain, ease the tension
C(bear)：语境句：I can't bear seeing children suffer like this. 固定搭配：bear in mind, bear the responsibility
D(hide)：语境句：She tried hard to hide her disappointment. 固定搭配：hide from, hide one's feelings

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。此处点题“The One I Admire”。作者通过写作思考，意识到不必刻意去将父亲当作神仙般“钦佩(admire)”，只需要作为一个儿子/女儿去爱他就足够了。
questions.supplement:
A(complain)：语境句：Customers often complain about the poor service. 固定搭配：complain about, complain to sb
B(memorize)：语境句：Actors have to memorize a lot of lines before filming. 固定搭配：memorize words, memorize the text
C(admire)：语境句：I really admire her courage to speak the truth. 固定搭配：admire sb for sth, secretly admire
D(forget)：语境句：I will never forget the day we first met. 固定搭配：forget to do, forget about

vocab_pack.definition_en: a task given by a teacher that requires writing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作宾语（被动语态 was given... written assignment），written 为过去分词作定语修饰 assignment，表示‘书面的’
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher gave us a written assignment on environmental protection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师给了我们一份关于环境保护的书面作业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was given a written assignment with the theme of "The One I Admire"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start writing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作目的状语（sat down to put pen to paper），不定式短语，put 为原形，整个短语为固定习语
vocab_pack.example_en: After days of thinking, she finally put pen to paper and wrote her first novel.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 思考了几天后，她终于动笔写下了她的第一部小说。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As I sat down to put pen to paper, many ideas rushed through my mind.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to pass through one's mind very quickly (ideas, thoughts)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般过去时，rushed 是 rush 的过去式，through my mind 作状语，主语 many ideas 为复数
vocab_pack.example_en: Various thoughts rush through my mind whenever I hear that song.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每当我听到那首歌，各种思绪就会涌上心头。
vocab_pack.from_passage: many ideas rushed through my mind.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to influence or determine the form, character, or development of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，一般过去时（shaped），主语 events and individuals，宾语 the person，表示‘塑造了今天的我’
vocab_pack.example_en: Childhood experiences often shape a person's personality.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 童年经历往往塑造一个人的性格。
vocab_pack.from_passage: There were so many events and individuals that shaped the person I was today.

vocab_pack.definition_en: after careful or extensive consideration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作时间状语，位于句首，after 为介词，much thought 为名词短语，整个短语修饰主句 decided
vocab_pack.example_en: After much thought, he decided to accept the job offer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经过深思熟虑后，他决定接受这份工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: After much thought, I decided to write about my dad who passed away last year.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to die (euphemistic)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为定语从句谓语，一般过去时（passed away），修饰先行词 dad，表示‘去年去世的父亲’
vocab_pack.example_en: Her grandfather passed away peacefully at the age of 90.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的祖父在90岁时安详地去世了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my dad who passed away last year

vocab_pack.definition_en: to direct one's thoughts toward someone or something; to consider
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动名词短语（Thinking about him）作主语，think about 的动名词形式，表示‘想到他’这件事
vocab_pack.example_en: Thinking about the future often makes me nervous.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 思考未来常常让我紧张。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Thinking about him in this way made me realize how much he changed my life.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a fundamental rule or principle that governs how life works
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作宾语（two laws of life），laws 为复数，of life 作后置定语，表示‘关于生活的法则’
vocab_pack.example_en: One important law of life is that hard work pays off.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一条重要的人生法则是努力终有回报。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I thought and thought about two laws of life that he had followed all his life.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to obey or act according to a rule, law, or advice
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在定语从句中作谓语，过去完成时（had followed），表示‘他一生都在遵循的法则’
vocab_pack.example_en: You should follow your parents' advice if it is reasonable.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果父母的建议合理，你应该遵循。
vocab_pack.from_passage: two laws of life that he had followed all his life

vocab_pack.definition_en: for the entire duration of one's life
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作时间状语，修饰 had followed，all 为限定词，his 是 one's 的具体形式，表示‘他的一生’
vocab_pack.example_en: She lived in that small town all her life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她一生都住在那个小镇上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he had followed all his life

vocab_pack.definition_en: in this manner; by doing this
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作方式状语，修饰 thinking about him，说明‘以这种方式思考他’
vocab_pack.example_en: In this way, we can solve the problem more efficiently.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通过这种方式，我们可以更高效地解决问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Thinking about him in this way made me realize ...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to understand or become aware of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为谓语结构（made me realize），make 后接宾语 me 和省略 to 的不定式 realize，为常见使役结构，过去时 made
vocab_pack.example_en: His speech made me realize the importance of teamwork.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的演讲让我意识到团队合作的重要性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Thinking about him in this way made me realize how much he changed my life.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to transform or greatly influence a person's life
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，一般过去时（changed），how much 引导感叹从句，my 为 one's 的具体形式
vocab_pack.example_en: Studying abroad can change your life in many ways.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 出国留学可以在很多方面改变你的人生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: how much he changed my life

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come into a particular family or social situation at birth
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 出生于（某种家庭或环境）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，被动语态（was born），是一般过去时，into a poor family 表示‘出生在一个贫困家庭’
vocab_pack.example_en: He was born into a family of musicians.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他出生在一个音乐家家庭。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My dad was born into a poor family.

vocab_pack.definition_en: knowledge or perception of a situation or fact
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作介词 despite 的宾语，awareness 为名词，后接 of 短语作定语，表示‘对问题的意识’
vocab_pack.example_en: Public awareness of climate change has increased greatly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公众对气候变化的意识已大大增强。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Despite his awareness of the problems caused by a stomach disorder

vocab_pack.definition_en: a medical condition that disrupts the normal functioning of the stomach
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作介词 by 的宾语，是原因状语的一部分，表示‘由胃病引起的问题’
vocab_pack.example_en: He was hospitalized due to a severe stomach disorder.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他因严重的胃病住院了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the problems caused by a stomach disorder

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause damage, suffering, or loss over time
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 造成损害；产生负面影响
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，一般过去时（took），its 指代疾病，toll 为名词，整个短语意为‘疾病最终对他造成了伤害’
vocab_pack.example_en: Years of stress took their toll on his health.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 多年的压力损害了他的健康。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the disease eventually took its toll on him.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be fully absorbed or overwhelmed by something (e.g., a state, emotion)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 陷入（某种状态）；完全沉浸于
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去分词短语作宾语补足语（see my father lost in...），lost 相当于形容词，表示‘父亲陷入混乱的世界中’
vocab_pack.example_en: She was lost in thought and didn't hear the doorbell.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她陷入沉思，没有听到门铃声。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It was very difficult for me to see my father lost in a world of turmoil.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to influence or have an impact on all parts of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，一般过去时（affected），every aspect of my life 作宾语，表示‘影响了我生活的每一方面’
vocab_pack.example_en: The new policy affects every aspect of our daily routine.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新政策影响我们日常生活的每一个方面。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He affected every aspect of my life from young child to teenager.

vocab_pack.definition_en: through the period of early childhood to adolescence
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 从幼年时期到青少年时期
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作时间状语，介词 from...to... 连接两个名词短语，表示时间范围，修饰 affected
vocab_pack.example_en: She experienced many changes from young child to teenager.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 从幼年到青少年，她经历了许多变化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He affected every aspect of my life from young child to teenager.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to sit next to someone, especially to offer companionship or support
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 坐在某人身边（尤指陪伴或支持）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，一般过去时（sat），at his side 作地点状语，表示‘坐在他身边’
vocab_pack.example_en: The nurse sat at the patient's side all night.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 护士整晚坐在病人身边。
vocab_pack.from_passage: So many times I sat at his side as he fought for his life in the hospital.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to struggle desperately to survive, especially during a serious illness or accident
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 为生存而战；奋力保住性命
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，一般过去时（fought），for his life 作目的状语，表示‘为他的生命而战斗’
vocab_pack.example_en: The injured hiker fought for his life in the hospital.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 受伤的徒步者在医院与死神搏斗。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as he fought for his life in the hospital

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who displays determination and courage in a difficult situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作表语（He was definitely a fighter），单数可数名词，前面有不定冠词 a，表示‘他是一个斗士’
vocab_pack.example_en: She is a fighter who never gives up, no matter how hard things get.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她是一个斗士，无论多么艰难都不会放弃。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He was definitely a fighter, but he could only fight for so long.

vocab_pack.definition_en: for a very long period of time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作时间状语，修饰 could fight，for 是介词，so long 为名词短语，表示‘只能战斗那么长时间’
vocab_pack.example_en: He waited for so long that he almost fell asleep.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他等了太久，几乎睡着了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he could only fight for so long.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be removed or separated from someone or something (used in passive voice)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中用于情态动词 could 之后，为被动语态原形（be taken from），表示‘一个父亲怎能被从家庭中夺走’
vocab_pack.example_en: How could such a talented artist be taken from us so soon?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这样一位才华横溢的艺术家怎能这么快就被从我们身边夺走？
vocab_pack.from_passage: How could a father be taken from his family?

vocab_pack.definition_en: to depend on or trust someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为不定式短语（to rely on），作目的状语，修饰 find，表示‘找不到任何人或任何东西可以依靠’
vocab_pack.example_en: You can always rely on me to help you.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你总能依赖我帮助你。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I couldn't find anyone else or anything else to rely on.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reduce the pain or sadness caused by a loss
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为不定式短语（to ease the loss），作 wanted 的宾语，ease 为原形，表示‘想要减轻他的死亡带来的损失’
vocab_pack.example_en: Talking to friends helped ease the loss she felt after her pet died.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 与朋友交谈帮助她减轻了宠物去世后的失落感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I wanted to ease the loss his death caused to me by believing he had been perfect.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to accept something as true or real
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动名词形式（believing），作介词 by 的宾语，表示‘通过相信他曾经完美’
vocab_pack.example_en: By believing in yourself, you can achieve great things.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通过相信自己，你可以取得巨大成就。
vocab_pack.from_passage: by believing he had been perfect

vocab_pack.definition_en: not always; not in all cases; possibly but not certainly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中修饰动词 admire，didn't 是 did not 的缩写表示否定，necessarily 加强语气，构成‘并不一定崇拜他’
vocab_pack.example_en: Famous people are not necessarily happy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 名人未必幸福。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I didn't necessarily admire him.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to express that something is necessary or required
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为谓语部分（needed to love），needed 是 need 的过去式，后接带 to 的不定式，表示‘过去需要爱他’
vocab_pack.example_en: She needed to rest after the long journey.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 长途旅行后她需要休息。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I just needed to love him.

section_2_word_form.passage:
The Beauty of Traditional Chinese Kites

In the heart of China, a story unfolds that is as old as time [56], a story of kites dancing in the sky. These kites, [57] their bright colors and complicated designs, are not just toys; they are a symbol of hope, [58], and cultural heritage.

Each kite tells a different tale. Some depict dragonflies, with their delicate wings and vibrant eyes, [59] good luck and prosperity. Others [60] like phoenixes, which represent beauty and immortality. These kites are not just crafts; they are [61] of art, reflecting the skill and creativity of Chinese artisans.

The beauty of these kites goes beyond their appearance. It's in the way that they dance in the sky, [62] by the wind, free and unfettered. Watching them float and twist, one can almost feel the spirit of ancient China come alive.

The tradition of kite flying is not just a hobby [63] a way of life. It's a way to connect with nature, to forget the worries of the world, and to embrace the pure joy of flying. It's [64] story that has been passed down through generations, and continues to inspire and amaze us.

[65] the hearts of those watch, the kites dance in the sky.

questions.explanation: 考查代词（反身代词）。as old as time itself 是固定的文学/诗歌表达，意为“和时间本身一样古老”，强调历史悠久。用 itself 强调 time。
questions.supplement: 正确形(itself)：语境句：The building itself is not very impressive, but the garden is beautiful. 固定搭配：by itself, in itself。原词it其它变形：its(形容词性/名词性物主代词)

questions.explanation: 考查介词。分析句子结构，逗号之间为插入语，表伴随状态或“带有/具有”，用 with 引导，意为“这些风筝，带有鲜艳的色彩和复杂的设计”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：The girl with long hair is my sister. 固定搭配：with the help of, be equipped with。原词无变形。

questions.explanation: 考查名词。此处和前面的 hope 以及后面的 cultural heritage 构成并列关系，作 of 的宾语，故需要将形容词 free 变为名词 freedom (自由)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(freedom)：语境句：They fought for freedom and equality. 固定搭配：freedom of speech, religious freedom。原词free其它变形：freely(adv.), freer(adj.比较级), freest(adj.最高级)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。主句谓语是 depict，此处表示伴随的状况或作后置定语补充说明 dragonflies，且 dragonflies 与 symbolize 之间是主动关系，故用现在分词 symbolizing。
questions.supplement: 正确形(symbolizing)：语境句：He gave her a ring, symbolizing his deep love. 固定搭配：无特殊固定搭配，常作伴随状语或定语。原词symbolize其它变形：symbol(n.), symbolic(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查被动语态与主谓一致。shape 在此作动词，意为“把……塑造成”。风筝(Others)是被塑造成凤凰的形状的，用被动语态；结合上下文，时态为一般现在时，主语 Others 为复数，故填 are shaped。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are shaped)：语境句：These cookies are shaped like stars. 固定搭配：be shaped like, take shape。原词shape其它变形：shapeless(adj.), shapely(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。work 作为“作品”讲时是可数名词。主语 They (指代风筝) 为复数，所以应当是“艺术作品(works of art)”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(works)：语境句：The museum displays many famous works of art. 固定搭配：works of art, literary works。原词work其它变形：worker(n.), working(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。风筝(they)与 carry(携带、吹拂)之间是逻辑上的动宾(被动)关系，故用过去分词 carried 作状语，意为“被风吹拂着”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(carried)：语境句：Carried away by the music, she started to dance. 固定搭配：get carried away, be carried out。原词carry其它变形：carries(第三人称单数), carrying(现在分词), carrier(n.)

questions.explanation: 考查连词。not just... but... 意为“不仅……而且……”，是固定句型 (相当于 not only... but also...)，连接两个并列成分 a hobby 和 a way of life。
questions.supplement: 正确形(but)：语境句：He is not just a teacher but a friend to us. 固定搭配：not just/only... but (also)..., nothing but。原词无变形。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。story 为可数名词单数，此处表示泛指“一个”被世代传承的故事，且 story 辅音音素开头，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：She told me a very interesting story yesterday. 固定搭配：a story of, tell a story。原词无变形。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。In the hearts of sb. 为固定表达，意为“在某人的心中”。此处指“在那些观看的人的心中，风筝在天空飞舞”。句首字母需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(In)：语境句：In the hearts of the people, he is a true hero. 固定搭配：in the heart of, keep in mind。原词无变形。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to open or spread out; to become gradually known or revealed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 a story 第三人称单数，所以用 unfolds 形式
vocab_pack.example_en: The mystery begins to unfold as the detective examines the clues.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着侦探检查线索，谜团开始展开。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a story unfolds that is as old as time itself

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely ancient; existing since the beginning of time
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 像时间一样古老；极其古老
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定比较结构，作表语，描述故事的历史悠久
vocab_pack.example_en: The tradition of celebrating harvest is as old as time itself.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 庆祝丰收的传统像时间一样古老。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a story unfolds that is as old as time itself

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move gracefully in the air (like a kite or bird)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语 dancing 作定语修饰 kites，表示“在空中舞动的风筝”
vocab_pack.example_en: The colorful lanterns danced in the sky during the festival.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 节日期间，五彩灯笼在空中舞动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a story of kites dancing in the sky

vocab_pack.definition_en: vivid, intense color
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式 colors，与前面的 their 对应，表示风筝具有多种明亮颜色
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist uses bright colors to attract attention.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 艺术家使用明亮的颜色来吸引注意。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with their bright colors and complicated designs

vocab_pack.definition_en: a pattern or structure that is complex and intricate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数名词，与 bright colors 并列，说明风筝的图案复杂
vocab_pack.example_en: The building features complicated designs on its walls.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座建筑的墙壁上有复杂的设计。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with their bright colors and complicated designs

vocab_pack.definition_en: not only; more than just
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 用于否定，强调风筝不仅仅是玩具，后接名词 toys
vocab_pack.example_en: This is not just a job; it is a responsibility.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这不仅仅是工作；这是一份责任。
vocab_pack.from_passage: are not just toys

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that represents or stands for something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词 symbol 后接 of 短语作定语，表示“希望、自由和文化遗产的象征”
vocab_pack.example_en: The dove is a symbol of peace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸽子是和平的象征。
vocab_pack.from_passage: they are a symbol of hope, freedom, and cultural heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: the traditions, customs, and values passed down from previous generations
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作介词 of 的宾语，与 hope、freedom 并列
vocab_pack.example_en: We must protect our cultural heritage for future generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须为后代保护我们的文化遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a symbol of hope, freedom, and cultural heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: to narrate a story
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 each kite 第三人称单数，所以用 tells；a different tale 为宾语
vocab_pack.example_en: The old man told a tale of adventure.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老人讲述了一个冒险故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Each kite tells a different tale.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to represent or show something in a picture or story
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 some（复数）所以用动词原形 depict，后接宾语 dragonflies
vocab_pack.example_en: The painting depicts a peaceful countryside scene.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这幅画描绘了宁静的乡村景色。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Some depict dragonflies

vocab_pack.definition_en: a wing that is fine, thin, and easily damaged
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，与后面的 vibrant eyes 并列，描述蜻蜓的特征
vocab_pack.example_en: The butterfly's delicate wings shimmer in the sunlight.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 蝴蝶精致的翅膀在阳光下闪闪发光。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with their delicate wings and vibrant eyes

vocab_pack.definition_en: an eye that is bright and full of life
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数名词，与 delicate wings 并列
vocab_pack.example_en: The cat's vibrant eyes stared into the darkness.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 猫那充满活力的眼睛凝视着黑暗。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with their delicate wings and vibrant eyes

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be a symbol of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语，作定语修饰 dragonflies，表示“象征好运和繁荣的蜻蜓”
vocab_pack.example_en: The red rose symbolizes love and passion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 红玫瑰象征爱情与激情。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Some depict dragonflies... symbolizing good luck and prosperity

vocab_pack.definition_en: having the form of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作表语，表示被动（被做成……形状），主语 Others 即其他风筝
vocab_pack.example_en: The cloud is shaped like a whale.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那朵云形状像一头鲸鱼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Others are shaped like phoenixes

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stand for or be a symbol of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 which（指代 phoenixes）复数，所以用动词原形 represent
vocab_pack.example_en: The five rings represent the five continents.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 五环代表五大洲。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which represent beauty and immortality

vocab_pack.definition_en: a piece of creative work that is of high quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式 works，作表语，强调风筝是艺术品
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum houses many works of art from the Renaissance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆收藏了许多文艺复兴时期的艺术作品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: they are works of art

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or be a sign of a particular situation or feeling
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语，作状语或定语，意为“反映着中国工匠的技能和创造力”
vocab_pack.example_en: The report reflects the company's commitment to quality.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这份报告反映了公司对质量的承诺。
vocab_pack.from_passage: reflecting the skill and creativity of Chinese artisans

vocab_pack.definition_en: to exceed or extend further than
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 beauty 第三人称单数，所以用 goes；beyond 为介词
vocab_pack.example_en: His kindness goes beyond what words can describe.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的善良超越了言语所能描述的程度。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The beauty of these kites goes beyond their appearance.

vocab_pack.definition_en: in the manner that; as
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 引导方式状语从句，说明美存在于风筝舞动的方式中
vocab_pack.example_en: I like the way that she solves problems.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我喜欢她解决问题的方式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It's in the way that they dance in the sky

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be transported or moved by the wind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语 carried 作定语，表示被动（被风携带），修饰 they (kites)
vocab_pack.example_en: The leaves are carried by the wind across the field.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 树叶被风吹过田野。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carried by the wind

vocab_pack.definition_en: without any restrictions or limitations
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 并列形容词短语，作主语补足语，描述风筝在空中自由自在的状态
vocab_pack.example_en: The birds flew free and unfettered above the mountains.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸟儿在群山上空自由无拘地飞翔。
vocab_pack.from_passage: free and unfettered

vocab_pack.definition_en: to observe someone performing an action (without 'to')
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 看着某人做某事（感官动词+宾语+省略to的不定式）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作状语，watch 后接宾语 them 和省略 to 的不定式 float and twist
vocab_pack.example_en: I watched the children play in the park.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我看着孩子们在公园里玩耍。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Watching them float and twist

vocab_pack.definition_en: to experience a particular emotion or sensation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 情态动词 can 后的动词原形，后接宾语 the spirit 和宾语补足语 come alive（省略 to）
vocab_pack.example_en: You can feel the tension in the room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你能感受到房间里的紧张气氛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: one can almost feel the spirit of ancient China come alive

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become lively or active; to seem real and vivid
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在感官动词 feel 后作宾语补足语，用动词原形（省略 to），描述 spirit 变得鲜活
vocab_pack.example_en: The city comes alive at night with music and lights.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 夜晚，城市随着音乐和灯光活跃起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: feel the spirit of ancient China come alive

vocab_pack.definition_en: a long-established custom or practice related to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词 tradition 后接 of 短语，说明是“放风筝的传统”
vocab_pack.example_en: The tradition of giving red envelopes during New Year is very popular.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新年发红包的传统非常流行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The tradition of kite flying

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: not just a hobby but a way of life
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize that something is not only one thing, but also another more important thing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 并列结构，连接两个名词短语 a hobby 和 a way of life，形成对比强调
vocab_pack.example_en: This is not just a movie but a masterpiece.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这不仅仅是一部电影，更是一部杰作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The tradition of kite flying is not just a hobby but a way of life.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to establish a relationship or link with someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语 to connect with，作目的状语，表示“与自然建立联系”
vocab_pack.example_en: Spending time in nature helps me connect with myself.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 花时间在大自然中帮助我与自己建立联系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a way to connect with nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: all the concerns and problems of everyday life
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数名词短语，作 forget 的宾语，表示“忘记世间的烦恼”
vocab_pack.example_en: Sometimes a vacation helps you forget the worries of the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有时候度假能帮你忘记世间的烦恼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to forget the worries of the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: to accept or take up something willingly and enthusiastically
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to embrace，与 to forget 并列，表示目的
vocab_pack.example_en: We should embrace every challenge as an opportunity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该把每一个挑战当作机会来拥抱。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to embrace the pure joy of flying

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give or teach something to someone younger or later
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时的被动语态 has been passed down，pass down 的过去分词形式
vocab_pack.example_en: This recipe has been passed down through generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个食谱已经代代相传。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It's a story that has been passed down through generations

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep doing something without stopping
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 it 第三人称单数，所以用 continues；后接不定式 to inspire and amaze
vocab_pack.example_en: She continues to work hard despite the difficulties.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管有困难，她继续努力工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: and continues to inspire and amaze us

vocab_pack.definition_en: in the deepest feelings or thoughts of someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，复数 hearts 表示“那些观看的人的心中”；原文中“those watch”疑为“those who watch”的简略形式，但此处依原文保留
vocab_pack.example_en: In the hearts of the people, she is a true hero.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在人民心中，她是一位真正的英雄。
vocab_pack.from_passage: In the hearts of those watch, the kites dance in the sky.
